$comment: THE single source of area conversion factors. Read by backend/app/utils/geo.py
and by frontend/src/utils/area.ts. Neither may hold a factor of its own: a
console that converts square metres differently from the engine produces a
report whose area and rate contradict its total.
Every factor is square feet per one unit, as an exact decimal string. Strings,
not numbers, because JSON numbers are doubles and this table feeds Decimal
arithmetic on figures that run to crores.
STATE-DEPENDENT UNITS ARE NOT SEEDED AS VERIFIED. A bigha is not one area: it
differs by state and, within a state, by district, and the values below are the
commonly cited ones rather than a notified schedule. Each carries `verified:
false` and the engine refuses to use an unverified factor unless the caller
opts in explicitly. Verifying them against the notified schedules is §11.2 of
the sprint plan — a standing cost with an owner and a review cadence, still

sqm.label: sq m
sqm.source: 1 m = 3.280839895013123 ft exactly (1 in = 25.4 mm), squared

guntha.label: guntha
guntha.source: 1/40 acre — uniform wherever used (MH, KA, TG)

bigha.label: bigha
bigha.note: Varies by state and by district. Never resolve without a jurisdiction.

UP.source: commonly cited pucca bigha; VERIFY against the state's notified schedule

PB.source: commonly cited kachha bigha; VERIFY — pucca differs

biswa.label: biswa
biswa.note: A fraction of a bigha, and the fraction itself varies.

UP.source: 1/20 of a 27,000 sq ft bigha; VERIFY

HR.source: 1/20 of a 27,225 sq ft bigha; VERIFY
